fundamental.summary: WRB shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 91 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (3.7 years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (293.76) indicates extreme market stress; financials sector particularly vulnerable to credit deterioration and economic contraction despite 91-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above major moving averages with rising RSI across all timeframes and supertrend bullish alignment provides solid technical structure in extreme fear environment (32/100 fear-greed) offering contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 293.76), zero fundamental momentum (no insider activity, no institutional signal), no active strategy trigger, and price below Hull MA and TEMA create a high-risk setup lacking confirmation in unfavorable environment.
